title: Letter: The LDS president’s silence on injustices is not restraint. It is complicity, dressed in reverence.
text:
(The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints) President Dallin H. Oaks speaks at the end of the afternoon session of General Conference at the Conference Center in Salt Lake City, Sunday, April 5, 2026.
